elaine-cs: FYI incoming onboarding request from Atlas Logistics. They want to run a proprietary reranker on Dedicated. Key asks: HSM for keys, VPC-only control plane, 50ms p95, and a safety/bias sweep before prod. Alex pasted the original message below.

alex_atlas: Hey team — Atlas here. We have a reranker (fine-tuned BERT-ish) that reorders search results for last-mile shipments. Need private infra (we can't send data to shared pools). Target traffic 300 rps with low latency. Can we do dedicated + slot reservation? Also need an eval plan for relevance + fairness on country-level ZIP biases.

mike-se: @elaine-cs @alex_atlas I can own the infra side. Quick Qs: what's the typical sequence length and average tokens per request? any heavy context blobs? Also do you need prefix caching / KV cache for any long-context reranking?

alex_atlas: seqs are short — <= 256 tokens (usually title + 1–3 metadata fields). No long chat style context. We do send a compressed attributes blob (~1kb) sometimes.

ryan-eng: For 50ms p95 at 300 rps we'll likely need 2 dedicated GPU workers with continuous batching disabled (reranker runs single-shot), or a single high-SKU with isolated pool. Need model size + quantization target. Do we have a compiled quantized artifact?

alex_atlas: Model is 6B FP16 today. We are open to 4-bit quantization if quality holds. We can run a calibration eval set.

mike-se: ok. Two things we need from Atlas to scope Dedicated: 1) a 500–1000 sample eval set (reference ranking + scores) for quality + drift checks; 2) a safety/bias rubric (we can help draft). Also confirm KMS/HSM vendor (AWS KMS, CloudHSM, or customer HSM?).

alex_atlas: Sending eval set by EOD. KMS is customer-managed AWS KMS key (we use a private account). HSM not required if KMS envelope keys ok.

anya-ps: heads-up on renewal risk: Atlas is on a mid-market contract now; if latency/cost miss we risk churn. Let's capture success metrics: p95 <= 60ms, throughput >= 250 rps, relevance lift >= 6% (NDCG@10), and no high-severity bias findings. Also need enablement docs for their ML/infra teams.

elaine-cs: noted. I'll create a customer success checklist and call out enablement session + runbook handoff. Draft rollout timeline:
- Week 0: receive eval set + KMS details
- Week 1: infra sizing + dry-run on staging Dedicated
- Week 2: safety & relevance evals, quality gates
- Week 3: canary traffic + monitoring = full prod if green

mike-se: sample model deployment config for our infra (for internal scoping):
```json
{
  "model": "atlas-reranker-v1",
  "deployment": "dedicated",
  "gpu_type": "a800-80gb",
  "replicas": "2",
  "kms": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd",
  "slo_p95_ms": "50",
  "max_seq": "256"
}
```

ryan-eng: Also add an eval harness note: we should run NDCG, fairness per-country, latency trace, and a perturbation suite. Please include a small sample prompt runner, e.g.:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/predict -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"atlas-reranker-v1","inputs":[{"query":"package delayed","candidates":["ETA 2 days","Delayed due to weather","Out for delivery"]}]}'
```

deploy-bot: Dedicated slot reservation created: reservation_id=rsv-20260321-09, expires=2026-04-04T18:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

elaine-cs: Great — next steps: @alex_atlas upload eval set + sample responses to shared S3 (instructions sent). @mike-se can you confirm infra estimate and cost range? @ryan-eng can you draft the eval harness template? I'll schedule an enablement call for next Tue 10am PT.

mike-se: I'll post sizing + estimated monthly commit by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

ryan-eng: I'll sketch the harness and include a checklist: NDCG calc, per-country slice, latency p95 traces, and regression alert thresholds.

alex_atlas: Thanks all — pulling the eval set together now. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:

elaine-cs: tagging this as high-priority for CS onboarding. I'll attach the checklist and keep the thread updated. :eyes:
